title: Ball-integral limit at a flat blow-up for β ≥ 0
statement:
Let V be an n-varifold on an open U ⊆ ℝ^N, x ∈ U, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ ∈ ℝ. Let l be a filter on a type ι and t : ι → ℝ with t_i → 0 within (0,∞) along l. Suppose that for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)), ∫ f dV_{x,t_i} → θ ∫ f dv(T) along l, where V_{x,r} = rescaledMeasure V x r and v(T) = planeVarifoldMeasure T. Then for every continuous β : G(N,n) → ℝ with β ≥ 0,
(∫_{B_{t_i}(x)×G(N,n)} β(S) dV(y,S)) / t_i^n → θ·ω_n·β(T) along l,
where B_r(x) is the closed ball and ω_n = (unitBallVolume n).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ) {ι : Type} (l : Filter ι) (t : ι → ℝ), x ∈ U → Tendsto t l (𝓝[>] 0) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(rescaledMeasure V x (t i))) l (𝓝 (θ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure T)))) → ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → Tendsto (fun i ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x (t i) ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / t i ^ n) l (𝓝 (θ * (unitBallVolume n).toReal * β T))
